name: openbb_economy_risk_premium
description:
Equity market risk premium by country (total equity and country risk premium) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.risk_premium).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp; default fmp).
Another source: fmp_market_risk_premium. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
